boundary_evidence: HISTORY: WHOLE UNIT. tu_map calls 0x020fa75c..0x020ff3ec one contiguous linker run of 75 functions (build/tu_map.json, tools/tu_map.py). This TU licenses all 75, ROM ordinals 0..74, as one .text claim. Below it is src/minigames/d_s_mg_m_carlo2.cpp (ends 0x020fa75c with _ZN19dMgMCarlo2CardObj_cC1Ev); above it is dScMgPachinko_c_classInit in src/d_s_mg_pachinko.cpp (0x020ff3ec..0x020ff420), which tu_map does not put in this unit and which stays its own file, and then _ZN16dScMgPachinko2_cD1Ev, the next class.

WIDENED from the earlier 45-function claim 0x020fa75c..0x020fc8c0. It stopped at PachinkoBall_DrawAll, the one function in the run that did not byte-match; that function now matches in its own commit, so the run is one piece. 30 shards were folded, all above the old claim: PachinkoBall_DrawAll through Pachinko_ResetRound, then the four own overrides OnYoshiTryEat, Render, Behavior and InitResources.

DESTRUCTOR ORDER. The cartridge has D1 at 0x020fa75c below D0 at 0x020fa780 and no D2 home. One out-of-line ~dScMgPachinko_c() under #pragma defer_codegen off emits D1 then D0 in that order; the D2 mwccarm also emits is a compiler_only_output deadstrip row.

KEY FUNCTION. The out-of-line destructor is the class's first declared virtual, so this TU emits _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS15dScMgPachinko_c and the ancestor RTTI chain (fBase_c, dBase_c, dScene_c, dScMgBase_c). Each is a deadstrip-data row with its canonical symbols.txt home; ov006 .data stays ROM-owned, so the TU stays text-only.
HISTORY: SOURCE ORDER IS ROM-ASCENDING, lowest address first, under #pragma defer_codegen off; tubuild verify reports all 75 in ROM-ascending emission order.

notes: Hand-assembled from the 45 legacy one-function sources of ROM ordinals 0..44, then widened by hand to the whole unit with the 30 of ordinals 45..74. tools/tubuild.py create cannot be used on this TU: several of the shards wrap their bodies in an extern "C" block, which its splitter refuses by design.

DECLARATION RECONCILIATION, all of it codegen-free and all of it settled by the 75/75 byte match rather than by argument. One extern "C" declaration per symbol at file scope; where two shards spelled one interface differently the definition's spelling (or the tree's dominant one) was kept and the call site took a cast. Mg_RenderSpriteBoth takes void* first and returns void. The G2 and G2S BG accessors are called through namespace declarations with their definitions' return types (G2: void*; G2S: unsigned); callers that want a char* or u16* cast at the use. DecompressLZ16 takes (void*, void*). Mg_InitBrush's second parameter is char. Mg_RenderSpriteBothScaled takes an OamAttr* first and returns int; the sprite record is only handled by pointer. MultiStore16 takes char*. func_02012468's eighth parameter is short. func_02012718 takes (int, int), its definition's spelling; PachinkoBall_CheckHitByBobOmb had passed its first argument through a void* cast and now passes the int table entry. cstd::sqrt and Sound::PlayBank2_2D are called through their namespace declarations; _ZN4cstd5atan2E5Fix12IiES1_ keeps its mangled C spelling, declared short(int, int) as its definition is. PachinkoDeco_UpdateAll, PachinkoFlyer_CheckHits and PachinkoFlyer_StateCross keep their own definitions' char* parameter and the shadow-class call sites cast. Pachinko_PlotSubBg2Pixels's first parameter is spelled void* rather than the definition's int: it is never read. Pachinko_DrawScore and Pachinko_DrawTopRecord take an unnamed void*: Render passes the scene in r0 and neither reads it (the move into r0 before each call is in the cartridge). Render and Behavior pass `this` cast to each helper's own parameter type (char*, u8*, C*, C2*).

TWO SHIM-CLASS RENAMES. Ordinals 10 and 23 each dispatch through an ov006 pointer-to-member table and each legacy shard had called its receiver `struct C`, but the two spellings place their fields at DIFFERENT offsets (0x5c0e/0x5c0f against 0x5bc6/0x5bc8), so they are two different shadow classes that happened to share a name; the second is now C2 with its own PMF2. Ordinals 21 and 43 had likewise both named a local record `Ent` with different layouts; the second is now Ent7d0, and ordinals 57 and 62, whose shards declared the same {code pointer, adjustment} record as `Ent`, use Ent7d0 too. In both pointer-to-member cases the typedef is still formed while the class is INCOMPLETE, which is load-bearing -- mwccarm 2004/b56 picks its pointer-to-member representation from the completeness of the class at the point the type is formed. PachinkoBall_CheckFall and PachinkoBobOmb_DrawAll had named their char* parameter `this`, which C++ reserves; it is `thiz` here.

PRAGMAS. Optimisation pragmas inherited from the legacy shards are carried as positional push/off/pop brackets -- opt_common_subs on ordinals 17, 22, 36, 42, 47 and 48, opt_loop_invariants on ordinals 35 and 36, opt_prelinearize on ordinal 45 (PachinkoBall_DrawAll) and opt_propagation on ordinal 65 (PachinkoBobOmb_StateAim) -- which is what #pragma defer_codegen off makes bind per-bracket instead of leaking file-wide. defer_codegen off also forces the ROM-ASCENDING source order: with codegen deferred mwccarm emits one .text section per function in the REVERSE of source order, and verify confirms all 75 land in the expected ROM-ascending section order.

compiler_only_output.reason: Homeless. mwcc emits three destructor variants from the one out-of-line definition -- D1, D0, D2 -- but the cartridge carries only D1 (0x020fa75c) and D0 (0x020fa780), which are adjacent: 0x020fa780 - 0x020fa75c = 0x24, exactly D1's size, so the image has no room for a D2 between them. dScMgPachinko_c is a confirmed leaf -- include/dScMgPachinko_c.h records that tools/rtti_extract.py finds no RTTI record naming it as a base -- so its own D2 is never odr-used. _ZN15dScMgPachinko_cD2Ev appears in no symbols.txt anywhere in the tree (arm9, itcm/dtcm and every overlay were searched) and in no delinks.txt, so it has no ROM home at all -- plain deadstrip rather than deadstrip-duplicate, and production isolation discards it. tubuild verify reports it as EXTRA .text size=0x24; it does not disturb the licensed run's ROM-ascending emission order, which verify reports as all 75 function(s) in the expected order.

The class's own vtable, emitted because this TU owns the key function. Extent corroborated two ways that agree: (a) the address point in config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt is 0x0213d9cc and the next data symbol is pmf_dScMgPachinko2_c_Paddle_StateOrbit at 0x0213da5c, giving symbol extent 0x90 = 36 slots and STORAGE 0x0213d9c4..0x0213da5c = 0x98 once the 8-byte offset-to-top/typeinfo preamble is counted; (b) tubuild verify reports the emitted .data section for this symbol as exactly size=0x98. tools/rtti_vtables.py --own reports 39 slots, and the three beyond 36 are SPURIOUS -- include/dScMgPachinko_c.h already records that its slot 36 and slot 38 readings (Paddle_StateOrbit and dScMgPachinko2_c_classInit) belong to the neighbouring g_profile_MG_TAMAIRE spawn descriptor at 0x0213da64, not to this class; the address-gap math above is what settles it, and the emitted size is the independent second witness. The cartridge keeps its canonical copy at the address point ov006:0x0213d9cc, outside this TU's only licensed range (.text 0x020fa75c-0x020ff3ec), so dsd delinks it from the cartridge independently and discarding this object's copy cannot cost the image a byte.
